biotools.summary: PDMD is a manually curated web database of medicinal plants and their phytocompounds experimentally reported to benefit muscle-wasting conditions (e.g., sarcopenia, cachexia, muscle atrophy), providing taxonomic, phytochemical-class, and SMILES annotations cross-referenced with PubChem and PubMed.
